Positions: az = degrees clockwise from TRUE north, r = metres, both measured from the FITTED centre of the sarsen circle (not the provisional site origin). Sizes: w tangential width, t radial thickness, h height above ground (lintels: vertical depth; fallen stones: height when standing). state1625 reasoned backwards from Stukeley (1720s), Wood (1740), Barclay 1895 and dated 19th-20th century events.

_meta.numbering: Petrie 1880: sarsen uprights 1-30 clockwise from the axis (stone 1 just east of it); lintel k = 100 + number of the higher (western, clockwise) of the two uprights it spans, so 102 is on 1-2 and 101 on 30-1; trilithons 51-60 clockwise from the NE-east end; bluestone circle 31-49; horseshoe 61-72.
